prompt: Use the attached approved Takeda Shingen setting sheet only as identity and costume reference; ignore its three-view layout and all banner lettering. Create ONE square 256px-style HUD face icon, chest-up, painterly Japanese historical action-game illustration. Shingen is an imposing older Japanese commander with intense eyes, a thick dark moustache and beard, a voluminous long white mane framing his face, black and antique-gold kabuto with his distinctive paired upward crescent horns, dark crimson-and-black lacquered armor with restrained gold edging and diamond crest. Three-quarter view facing right, calm battle-tested expression. Keep the full horn tips and recognizable white hair, face and shoulders readable at tiny HUD size with 8% breathing room. Flat uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background edge to edge. No banner, weapons, text, kanji, calligraphy, scenery, frame, effects, watermark, or other people. Match the graphic painterly treatment of existing game HUD portraits; not photorealistic.
background: #FF00FF exact pure magenta; outer16 pixels verified
placementTransform: Keyed generated near-magenta background by per-pixel deviation max(255-R,G,255-B): transparent at <=18, opaque at >=55, linear antialias between; uniformly resized to 82% of 256x256 canvas and centered on exact #FF00FF RGB background. Original generated source preserved unchanged.
automaticCheck: PASS: visible silhouette margins >=8px on each edge
